name: Tatsumi Port Island, Japan
description: The city Persona 3 invents for itself: an artificial island built by the Kirijo Group, joined by the Moonlight Bridge to Iwatodai on the mainland. Its makers drew on Tokyo's Odaiba and Kobe's Port Island; the pin is on Kobe's Port Island, the one it shares a name with, and is a choice between the two.
